provides: Media management: image/video/file/audio upload, processing (thumbnail/preview generation via libvips, ffprobe/ffmpeg metadata and poster/waveform rendering) and CDN ref tracking, with a media-submodule opt-in (images core, video/recordings behind ENABLED_SUBMODULES + ffmpeg system checks), an open media-kind registry, a budgeted inline preview (blur-up / poster / waveform) every attachment carries, a watermark seam, upload speed-limiting, cdn.describe / cdn.describe_many / cdn.media_exists / cdn.refs_sync comm Functions for other modules to render, check and sync media without importing this package, and a batched POST /describe/ endpoint so a browser — which has no comm bus — can resolve that same snapshot for refs it holds but did not upload.

curated.summary: Image.type choices — the same STAPEL_CDN key the client-side CdnImageField reads, so server validation and client typing agree on what's legal. Default is the zero-infrastructure 'avatar' only; marketplace-specific types (product/chat/review) are added explicitly by the host (conf.py, MODULE.md Extension points table).
curated.business_label: Which image categories this deployment accepts

curated.summary: Which of images/video/recordings this deployment turns on. images needs no opt-in; adding video/recordings activates the ffmpeg system-check probe for that submodule (conf.py, MODULE.md 'Media submodules').
curated.business_label: Enabled media types (images / video / audio recordings)

curated.summary: Dotted path to (or direct callable) a watermark engine applied to preview variants; empty disables watermarking (conf.py, MODULE.md 'Storage / processing backends').

Open media-kind registry merged over stapel_cdn.kinds.BUILTIN_MEDIA_KINDS (image/gif/video/audio/file); an entry replaces a builtin, None removes it. A kind decides what the inline preview holds (blur/poster/waveform/none) and whether the object is animated — so stickers, or any later kind, are a dict literal in settings rather than a release here (kinds.py, MODULE.md 'Media kinds').
curated.business_label: Which kinds of attachment this deployment renders

curated.summary: Permission classes (dotted paths, ALL must pass) of POST /describe/, resolved at request time. The default is the seam the read endpoints use: signed in (guest sessions included) or an internal service call. The endpoint answers for refs the caller did not upload — the case it exists for — and its snapshot names no uploader, filename or refs[], which is why it is not owner-scoped the way file/exists/ is. Tighten to IsServiceRequest to keep describe service-side, or open to AllowAny for public media (conf.py, MODULE.md 'The render-metadata contract').
curated.business_label: Who may look up attachment metadata

curated.summary: Byte ceiling for ONE inline preview, measured on the finished data: URI. Enforced by downgrade-then-refuse (WebP quality ladder, smaller waveform strip, then no preview with meta_reason 'preview_over_budget') and applied on read as well as at ingest — never by truncation (metadata.py, CONFIG.MD).
curated.business_label: How much inline placeholder weight a page may carry

extension_points.name: WATERMARK
extension_points.summary: The only dotted-path key in the namespace: a callable (pyvips.Image) -> pyvips.Image; built-in reference stapel_cdn.watermarks.text_watermark renders WATERMARK_TEXT (MODULE.md 'Storage / processing backends').

extension_points.name: ASSET_TYPES
extension_points.summary: Read through the callable models.get_image_type_choices, so adding types never produces a model/migration change (MODULE.md Extension points table).

extension_points.name: serializer_seams
extension_points.summary: Every view in stapel_cdn.views mixes in SerializerSeamMixin (request_serializer_class/response_serializer_class + get_* getters); subclass and re-route the URL to swap (views.py:62-79, MODULE.md 'Serializer seams').

extension_points.name: media_processed signal
extension_points.summary: stapel_core.signals.media_processed sent after ImageProcessingService.process_image() generates all variants — in-process hook for cache warm-up/denormalization (MODULE.md 'Signals').

extension_points.name: MEDIA_KINDS
extension_points.summary: Merge-over-builtins registry of media kinds; an entry is {model, extensions, asset_types, preview, animated} and None removes a builtin. Malformed entries are reported by checks.W009 rather than raising inside a request (kinds.py, MODULE.md 'Media kinds').

extension_points.name: DESCRIBE_PERMISSIONS
extension_points.summary: REPLACE seam for the guard of POST /describe/: dotted paths read at request time, defaulting to stapel_cdn.permissions.IsAuthenticatedOrService. A DRF permission list means 'all must pass', so the OR that matches the read endpoints ships as one importable class. Pinning permission_classes on a view subclass still wins — the setting is the default, not a ceiling (views.DescribeMediaView, MODULE.md 'The render-metadata contract').

surface.name: detect_image_extension
surface.intent: Magic-byte content check for fetched or uploaded image bytes: reads the DETECTED format from the file signature — never the URL suffix or the Content-Type header — and confirms it with a real libvips decode, raising ImageImportError otherwise. Pair with fetch_image_bytes for any external-image intake: trusting a URL's own extension is how a '.jpg' that is actually an HTML/script payload reaches storage.
instead_of: trusting the URL or Content-Type extension

surface.name: enforce_rate_limit
surface.intent: Per-caller fixed-window quota (STAPEL_CDN['IMPORT_FROM_URL_RATE']) guarding cdn's import-from-url egress path — call it before any DNS/network work on a caller-supplied URL, which is what stops the fetch from being turned into an open proxy/amplifier. Scoped to this one feature's bucket namespace; for a NEW feature's own rate limiting reach for stapel_core.gateway.ratelimit.CacheRateLimiter directly instead of repurposing this wrapper.

surface.name: fetch_image_bytes
surface.intent: SSRF-hardened fetch of a remote image over HTTPS: resolves and allowlists every hop's IP (rejects private/loopback/link-local/CGNAT/cloud-metadata ranges, including IPv4-mapped/6to4/NAT64 IPv6 forms), pins the TCP connection to the validated address to defeat DNS-rebinding, and caps size/timeout/redirect hops. Reach for this — not a bare HTTP client — anywhere a deployment fetches an attacker-influenced URL (an OAuth-provider avatar, a webhook-supplied image link); this is the only outbound-HTTP path stapel-cdn ships and it exists because that shape of fetch is a classic SSRF sink.

surface.name: sniff_is_active_content
surface.intent: Answer, from the leading BYTES alone, whether an upload is markup or script a browser would execute — HTML, SVG, XML, PHP, a shebang — ignoring the caller-supplied filename and Content-Type, and ignoring leading whitespace or a UTF-8 BOM used to walk past a naive prefix check. Reach for this on any non-image intake whose bytes end up under a path that a web server hands to a browser: extension and Content-Type are both written by the uploader, so a '.csv' or '.pdf' that actually starts with <script> runs in the media origin. Returns a bool; it is a refusal test, not a sanitiser — keep the extension/MIME allowlists in front of it.
instead_of: trusting the upload's extension or Content-Type

surface.name: validate_image_file
surface.intent: Validate an uploaded image before it touches hashing or storage: extension allowlist + the decompression-bomb pixel cap (STAPEL_CDN['MAX_IMAGE_PIXELS']) + a real decode with libvips — the SAME decoder stapel_cdn.services uses to process the file, so this gate can never refuse input the pipeline behind it would have handled. Reach for this on ANY image-intake path in the deployment, not only cdn's own upload views. Catch stapel_cdn.decoders.ImageDecoderUnavailable separately from ValidationError: it is a ValidationError subclass meaning 'this deployment has no decoder for that format', an operator's problem, and answering it as bad input is the defect that produced this note — a valid HEIC was refused as 'Invalid image file' because the guard asked Pillow while the pipeline read HEIC natively.

surface.name: text_watermark
surface.intent: The built-in WATERMARK engine (`(pyvips.Image) -> pyvips.Image`) the preview-generation pipeline applies when STAPEL_CDN['WATERMARK'] points at it. Point the setting here directly for a plain bottom-right text label (STAPEL_CDN['WATERMARK_TEXT']), or call it from your own callable to layer a logo/opacity effect on top — reach for this before writing a pyvips text/compositing routine from scratch.

requires.reason: comm bus (cdn.describe/cdn.describe_many/cdn.media_exists/cdn.refs_sync Functions, user.deleted/user.deletion_initiated consume for GDPR), AppSettings, error registry, SerializerSeamMixin/StapelAPIView canon in stapel_core.django.api.views (pyproject.toml dependency)
